item.title: Daily Minute — September 28, 2026
item.description:

item.title: Lesson 100: “My part is essential to God’s plan for salvation.”
item.description: “My part is essential to God’s plan for salvation.” Just as God’s Son completes his Father, so your part in it completes your Father’s plan. Salvation must reverse the mad belief in separate thoughts and separate bodies which lead separate lives and go their separate ways.
